title: wollastonia micrantha subsp. exigua
intro: Wollastonia micrantha subsp. exigua, commonly known as the Australian finger grass, is a plant species native to Australia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body, making it useful in treating digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Wollastonia micrantha subsp. exigua include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
